titulo: Haber de + infinitive: formal obligation, future, and Mexican probability
subtitulo: He de admitirlo. Ha de estar en su casa. Ha de haber salido.
regla: Haber de + infinitive = must (mild, formal obligation): He de admitir que... It can also mark a future action in literary style: lo que ha de venir. In Mexico, ha de + infinitive very often means a guess: Ha de estar en su casa (He must be at home). To guess about the past, Mexico uses ha de haber + participle: Ha de haber salido (He must have gone out).

lista.texto: **He de admitir que es difícil.** Everyday: **tengo que / debo**.
**Ha de estar dormido.** = _He must be asleep._ **Han de ser las tres.** = _It must be about three._
**Ha de haber salido.** = _He must have gone out._ **Han de haber llegado.** = _They must have arrived._

bloques.texto: The Mexican guess is everyday speech, like the future of probability (**estará**, **habrá salido**).
Also common: **has de saber que...** (_you should know that..._).
Tip: in Mexico, **ha de** is a shrug: _probably_.

lista.es: ==He de== tomar el tren de las diez para llegar a tiempo.
lista.en: I must take the ten o'clock train to arrive on time.

lista.es: ==Han de== respetar todas las señales de tránsito.
lista.en: You must obey all traffic signs.

lista.es: ==Hemos de== admitir que es más difícil de lo que pensábamos.
lista.en: We must admit it's harder than we thought.

lista.es: ==Has de== reconocer que los alumnos merecen un descanso.
lista.en: You have to admit the students deserve a break.

lista.es: No te preocupes por lo que nunca ==ha de== pasar.
lista.en: Don't worry about what will never happen.
He's not answering; he must be asleep.
There must be a lot of traffic.

lista.es: No contesta; ya ==ha de haber salido==.
lista.en: He's not answering; he must have gone out already.

lista.es: El piso está mojado; ==ha de haber llovido== en la noche.
lista.en: The floor is wet; it must have rained during the night.

lista.es: Hay platos sucios: los niños ==han de haber desayunado== aquí.
lista.en: There are dirty dishes: the kids must have had breakfast here.

lista.es: No encuentro mis llaves; las ==he de haber dejado== en el carro.
lista.en: I can't find my keys; I must have left them in the car.

bloques.texto: Usually there is a clue first (no contesta, el piso está mojado), then the guess.
Also very common in Mexico: **seguro** or **a lo mejor** + preterite: **Seguro llovió.**
Tip: ha de haber = must have. Think of a detective reading footprints: the clue, then **ha de haber**.

filas.t: He de admitirlo. / Tengo que admitirlo.
Ha de está en su casa.
Ha de estar en su casa.

lista.nota: **Haber** stays as it is, then the participle.

lista.texto: Guess about the past with the [[7266|future perfect]]; or [[9544|a lo mejor]] + preterite.

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: Mexican guess: _She must be at work._
lista.r: Ha de estar en el trabajo.

lista.p: Mexican guess: _He must have gone out._
Mexican guess: _They must have eaten already._
